title: Port non-blocking reader thread, locks, and rxOneShot from LICHEN SX1262.cs into extracted standalone version
close_reason: Verified done via extracted .extraction/renode-lora-peripherals/peripherals/sx126x/SX1262.cs (904 lines), member-level diffed against lichen/boards/renode/peripherals/SX1262.cs: readerThread+StartReader+ReaderLoop+DispatchMessage (non-blocking background RX, all socket reads off SPI thread); stateLock/connectionLock/writeLock present and applied on every state mutation (Reset, FinishTransmission, Transmit read paths, OnGPIO->Reset/FinishTransmission, EnterRxModeBridge incl. error paths, TriggerTx, ExitRxMode, setters, DispatchMessage); rxOneShot with full one-shot contract (set in EnterRxMode, cleared on packet/timeout/SetTx/SetStandby); latchedIrqFlags latched under stateLock in 0x12 handler; loopbackMode preserved (constructor param, Loopback property, TriggerTxLoopback/EnterRxModeLoopback). Fixed 2 parity gaps vs reference: DispatchMessage try/catch in ReaderLoop (prevented silent reader death) and wasOneShot log capture. CAVEAT: compilation NOT verified on this host - no dotnet/mono/mcs/csc installed (environment gap); compile+Renode test.resc smoke test tracked in project-LICHEN-worker6-184j. Fulfilled by child epic project-LICHEN-636h.3.
